mapper.sql: l.ledger_no, l.member_id, COALESCE(m.member_code, '平台') AS member_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.nickname, ''), NULLIF(m.legal_subject_name, ''), m.member_code, '平台') AS merchant_name, l.account_type, l.direction, l.biz_type, l.amount, l.balance_after, l.ref_type, l.pay_channel, l.pay_order_no, l.invoice_status, l.ledger_status, original_ledger.ledger_no AS original_ledger_no, DATE_FORMAT(l.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time, l.remark
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.direction = 1 AND l.ledger_status = 1 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncome, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.direction = 2 AND l.ledger_status = 1 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpense, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.direction = 1 AND l.ledger_status = 1 THEN l.amount WHEN l.direction = 2 AND l.ledger_status = 1 THEN -l.amount WHEN l.direction = 4 AND l.ledger_status = 1 THEN l.amount WHEN l.direction = 5 AND l.ledger_status = 1 THEN -l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS netAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.frozen_amount) FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_account` a WHERE a.is_delete = 0), 0) AS frozenAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.direction = 1 AND l.ledger_status = 1 AND l.create_time >= #{monthStart} THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthIncome, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.direction = 2 AND l.ledger_status = 1 AND l.create_time >= #{monthStart} THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthExpense, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.invoice_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingInvoiceCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.ledger_status IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abnormalLedgerCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` m WHERE m.is_delete = 0) AS merchantCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_payment_order` p WHERE p.is_delete = 0) AS paymentOrderCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_payment_order` p WHERE p.is_delete = 0 AND p.payment_status = 0) AS unpaidPaymentCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_status = 1 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_payment_order` p WHERE p.is_delete = 0) AS paidPaymentAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_status = 0 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_payment_order` p WHERE p.is_delete = 0) AS unpaidPaymentAmount FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_ledger` l WHERE l.is_delete = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_withdrawal` WHERE is_delete = 0 AND withdrawal_status = 0

SELECT m.member_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.nickname, ''), NULLIF(m.legal_subject_name, ''), m.member_code) AS merchant_name, m.legal_subject_name, COALESCE(a.value_added_available_amount, 0) + COALESCE(a.rental_settlement_available_amount, 0) + COALESCE(d.performance_deposit_available_amount, 0) AS available_amount, COALESCE(a.value_added_frozen_amount, 0) + COALESCE(a.rental_settlement_frozen_amount, 0) + COALESCE(d.performance_deposit_frozen_amount, 0) AS frozen_amount, COALESCE(a.value_added_available_amount, 0) AS value_added_available_amount, COALESCE(d.performance_deposit_available_amount, 0) AS performance_deposit_available_amount, COALESCE(d.performance_deposit_frozen_amount, 0) AS performance_deposit_frozen_amount, COALESCE(a.rental_settlement_available_amount, 0) AS rental_settlement_available_amount, COALESCE(a.rental_settlement_frozen_amount, 0) AS rental_settlement_frozen_amount, COALESCE(l.total_income, 0) AS total_income, COALESCE(l.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense, COALESCE(l.pending_invoice_count, 0) AS pending_invoice_count, COALESCE(l.abnormal_ledger_count, 0) AS abnormal_ledger_count FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, member_id, SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 1 THEN available_amount ELSE 0 END) AS value_added_available_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 1 THEN frozen_amount ELSE 0 END) AS value_added_frozen_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 3 THEN available_amount ELSE 0 END) AS rental_settlement_available_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 3 THEN frozen_amount ELSE 0 END) AS rental_settlement_frozen_amount FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_account` WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY tenant_id, member_id ) a ON a.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND a.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, member_id, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 1 AND ledger_status = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 2 AND ledger_status = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense, SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_invoice_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ledger_status IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_ledger_count FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_ledger` WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY tenant_id, member_id ) l ON l.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND l.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, member_id, SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 2 THEN available_amount ELSE 0 END) AS performance_deposit_available_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 2 THEN frozen_amount ELSE 0 END) AS performance_deposit_frozen_amount FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_account` WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY tenant_id, member_id ) d ON d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND d.member_id = m.member_id
m.is_delete = 0
AND (m.member_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.merchantKeyword}, '%') OR m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.merchantKeyword}, '%') OR m.legal_subject_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.merchantKeyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.member_id DESC
mapper.sql: w.withdrawal_no, m.member_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.nickname, ''), NULLIF(m.legal_subject_name, ''), m.member_code) AS merchant_name, w.amount, w.fee, w.actual_amount, w.withdrawal_channel, w.payee_name, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(w.payee_account) <= 7 THEN '******' ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(w.payee_account, 3), '****', RIGHT(w.payee_account, 4)) END AS payee_account, w.withdrawal_status, w.review_remark, DATE_FORMAT(w.review_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS review_time, DATE_FORMAT(w.paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS paid_time, DATE_FORMAT(w.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time, w.remark

w.is_delete = 0

SELECT
FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_withdrawal` w LEFT JOIN `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` m ON m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND m.member_id = w.member_id AND m.is_delete = 0 WHERE w.is_delete = 0 AND w.withdrawal_no = #{withdrawalNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT withdrawal_id AS withdrawalId, tenant_id AS tenantId, member_id AS memberId, account_id AS accountId, account_type AS accountType, amount, withdrawal_channel AS withdrawalChannel, withdrawal_status AS withdrawalStatus FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_withdrawal` WHERE withdrawal_no = #{withdrawalNo} AND is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT account_id AS accountId, available_amount AS availableAmount, frozen_amount AS frozenAmount, version, account_status AS accountStatus FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_account` WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND account_type = #{accountType} AND is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_account` SET available_amount = #{availableAmount}, frozen_amount = #{frozenAmount}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND version = #{version} AND account_status = 1 AND is_delete = 0

UPDATE `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_withdrawal` SET withdrawal_status = #{withdrawalStatus}, review_remark = #{reviewRemark}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_time = NOW(), paid_time = CASE WHEN #{withdrawalStatus} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, update_by = #{reviewerId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE withdrawal_id = #{withdrawalId} AND withdrawal_status = 0 AND is_delete = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_ledger` (tenant_id, member_id, account_type, ledger_no, direction, biz_type, amount, balance_after, ref_type, ref_id, pay_channel, pay_order_no, ledger_status, create_by, create_time, remark, is_delete) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{accountType}, #{ledgerNo}, #{direction}, 'withdrawal', #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, 'withdrawal', #{refId}, #{payChannel}, #{payOrderNo}, 1, #{operatorId}, NOW(), #{remark}, 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_ledger` l LEFT JOIN `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` m ON m.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND m.member_id = l.member_id AND m.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_ledger` original_ledger ON original_ledger.ledger_id = l.original_ledger_id AND original_ledger.is_delete = 0
l.is_delete = 0 AND l.ledger_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.ledgerNo}, '%') AND l.account_type = #{query.accountType}
AND (m.member_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.merchantKeyword}, '%') OR m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.merchantKeyword}, '%') OR m.legal_subject_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.merchantKeyword}, '%'))
AND l.direction = #{query.direction} AND l.biz_type = #{query.bizType} AND l.ledger_status = #{query.ledgerStatus} AND l.invoice_status = #{query.invoiceStatus} AND l.create_time >= #{query.beginTime} AND l.create_time <= #{query.endTime}
AND (LOWER(COALESCE(l.biz_type, '')) LIKE '%service%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.biz_type, '')) LIKE '%storage%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.biz_type, '')) LIKE '%recharge%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.biz_type, '')) LIKE '%增值%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.ref_type, '')) LIKE '%service%')
AND (LOWER(COALESCE(l.biz_type, '')) LIKE '%express%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.biz_type, '')) LIKE '%shipping%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.biz_type, '')) LIKE '%delivery%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.biz_type, '')) LIKE '%快递%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.biz_type, '')) LIKE '%物流%')
AND (LOWER(COALESCE(l.biz_type, '')) LIKE '%withdraw%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.biz_type, '')) LIKE '%提现%')
AND l.invoice_status IS NOT NULL AND l.ref_type IS NOT NULL AND l.ref_type <> ''
ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.ledger_id DESC

SELECT
FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_ledger` l LEFT JOIN `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` m ON m.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND m.member_id = l.member_id AND m.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_finance_ledger` original_ledger ON original_ledger.ledger_id = l.original_ledger_id AND original_ledger.is_delete = 0 WHERE l.is_delete = 0 AND l.ledger_no = #{ledgerNo}

SELECT p.payment_no, COALESCE(m.member_code, '平台') AS member_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.nickname, ''), NULLIF(m.legal_subject_name, ''), m.member_code, '平台') AS merchant_name, p.biz_type, p.biz_no, p.subject, p.amount, p.payment_status, p.alipay_trade_no, DATE_FORMAT(p.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time, DATE_FORMAT(p.expire_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expire_time, DATE_FORMAT(p.paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS paid_time, p.remark FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_payment_order` p LEFT JOIN `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` m ON m.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND m.member_id = p.member_id AND m.is_delete = 0
p.is_delete = 0 AND p.payment_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.paymentNo}, '%')
AND (m.member_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.merchantKeyword}, '%') OR m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.merchantKeyword}, '%') OR m.legal_subject_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.merchantKeyword}, '%'))
AND p.biz_type = #{query.bizType} AND p.payment_status = #{query.paymentStatus} AND p.create_time >= #{query.beginTime} AND p.create_time <= #{query.endTime}
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.payment_id DESC

SELECT p.payment_no, COALESCE(m.member_code, '平台') AS member_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.nickname, ''), NULLIF(m.legal_subject_name, ''), m.member_code, '平台') AS merchant_name, p.biz_type, p.biz_no, p.subject, p.amount, p.payment_status, p.alipay_trade_no, DATE_FORMAT(p.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time, DATE_FORMAT(p.expire_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expire_time, DATE_FORMAT(p.paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS paid_time, p.remark FROM `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_payment_order` p LEFT JOIN `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` m ON m.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND m.member_id = p.member_id AND m.is_delete = 0 WHERE p.is_delete = 0 AND p.payment_no = #{paymentNo}
